### Orthofix to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/785927921/files/doc_news/Orthofix-to-Report-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


***Company to Host Conference Call on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 8:30 am Eastern Time***


LEWISVILLE, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Orthofix Medical Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54627721&newsitemid=20261023041671&lan=en-US&anchor=Orthofix+Medical+Inc&index=1&md5=cf4e9d07d76c37957e6aca8094c5074c) . (NASDAQ:OFIX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 9, 2026, before market open. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to review results at 8:30 am Eastern Time the same day.


Interested parties may access the conference call by dialing 833-461-5787 in the U.S., and 585-542-9983 in all other locations, and referencing the conference ID 165 515 415. A webcast of the conference call and a copy of the release may be accessed at[ir.Orthofix.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.orthofix.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54627721&newsitemid=20261023041671&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.Orthofix.com.&index=2&md5=9db79d86e7d7a45e302c66dd78297958)

The Company encourages investors and potential investors to consult the Orthofix website regularly for important information about Orthofix.


**About Orthofix**


Orthofix is a global medical technology company dedicated to advancing healing and restoring mobility for patients with complex musculoskeletal conditions. Headquartered in Lewisville, Texas, the Company offers a differentiated portfolio of spinal implants, therapeutic solutions, limb reconstruction systems, biologics and enabling technologies, including the 7D FLASH™ Navigation System. Orthofix’s technology-enabled solutions are designed to support surgeons across the continuum of care and improve outcomes for patients. Learn more at[Orthofix.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54627721&newsitemid=20261023041671&lan=en-US&anchor=Orthofix.com&index=4&md5=e80965bff05e397511a630838fbd4c64) and follow Orthofix on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Forthofix%2Fposts%2F&esheet=54627721&newsitemid=20261023041671&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=d5c7dc32838351cc0d7d267e55b28513) .
